subject: general
question: Under the leadership of which of the following revolutionaries was Chittagong Armoury Raid conducted?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Surya Sen**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Chittagong Armoury Raid** (1930) was a significant revolutionary act against British rule in India, planned and led by **Surya Sen**, also known as **Masterda Surya Sen**.
 
• He was a prominent leader of the Indian independence movement in Bengal.
 
• The raid took place on **18 April 1930** in **Chittagong**, now in Bangladesh.
 
• Surya Sen and his group of revolutionaries aimed to:
 
 
• Seize weapons from the British armoury.
 
• Cut off communication lines like telephone and telegraph.
 
• Destroy the railway lines to disrupt British troop movements.
 
• The plan was to inspire a large-scale uprising against British colonial rule.
 
 
 
• Along with Surya Sen, other revolutionaries like **Ananta Singh**, **Kalpana Dutta**, **Pritilata Waddedar**, and **Badal Gupta** played crucial roles in the raid.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Rash Behari Bose:
 
 
• A revolutionary involved in the Ghadar Conspiracy and later in the Indian National Army movement but not associated with the Chittagong Armoury Raid.
 
 
 
• Badal Gupta:
 
 
• A participant in the revolutionary activities under Surya Sen but not the leader. He is known for his role in the Writers' Building attack in Kolkata.
 
 
 
• Hemu Kalani:
 
 
• A Sindhi freedom fighter active during the Quit India Movement, much later than the Chittagong Raid.
